items.title: Apache HTTP Server發布2.4.69版修補20個漏洞，包含3個重大漏洞
items.summary: Apache軟體基金會10月1日發布開源Web伺服器Apache HTTP Server更新，修補20個資安漏洞，涵蓋記憶體破壞、資訊洩漏、阻斷服務及權限管理等問題，影響2.4.0至2.4.68等版本，用戶應升級至已完成修補的2.4.69版。

items.title: OpenAI用內部模型挑戰4,000道數學問題，公開722篇研究手稿
items.summary: OpenAI周二（10/6）公布大批由內部前沿模型產生的數學研究成果，並在GitHub公開722篇研究手稿。OpenAI尚未公開產生這批成果的前沿模型，目前正研究如何以負責任的方式釋出。

items.summary: fix(heartbeat): deliver Android notification wakes when heartbeat.every is 0m (#166522) * test(heartbeat): cover node notification wakes with disabled cadence * fix(heartbeat): deliver node notification wakes with disabled cadence The node notifications.changed handler requests its wake as notifications-event/event/notifications-event, but the unscheduled-wake policy only admitted the immediate/"wake" shape used by system events and cron. With heartbeat.every "0m" both admission gates rejected the wake. Closes #166508 Co-authored-by: Jay Zhou

items.title: FBI傳與Accenture的承包商解約，疑因未修補PeopleSoft漏洞造成ShinyHunters入侵
items.summary: 美國聯邦調查局（FBI）向路透社證實，已與一家未及時部署修補程式的IT服務承包商解約。FBI資安主管Brett Leatherman表示，調查顯示先前的資料外洩事件，源自第三方管理平臺的資安失誤，承包商未部署已發布的安全更新，FBI因此與該承包商解約，並採取措施降低後續風險。

items.title: Anthropic擴大資安Claude存取計畫，Glasswing半年找到逾12萬漏洞
items.summary: Anthropic周二（10/6）宣布擴大Cyber Verification Program（CVP），整合原本分開運作的Project Glasswing，並重新分為3個資安存取層級，讓通過驗證的資安團隊可依工作需求，取得限制較少的Claude模型能力。Anthropic同時公布Project Glasswing成果，指出合作夥伴自今年4月至7月間已發現至少12.9萬個經驗證的軟體漏洞。

items.title: test(update): assert the detailed Node runtime refusal
items.summary: test(update): assert the detailed Node runtime refusal The target-runtime admission case still exits with code 1, records node-runtime-preflight, and refuses package installation. Its exact output expectation predates the named check and installation diagnostics in #166410. Require the complete current refusal: engines.node, target requirement, detected Node version and executable, resolved install root, entrypoint, Gateway ownership context, and unchanged recovery guidance. Keep every refusal and no-install assertion. Production behavior is unchanged. Validation: both reported update files passed 69 tests on Testbox; 143 update siblings and preflight-owner files passed under their owning configurations. The full infra configuration covered 1,942 files across six Linux partitions. Four AWS worktree cases correctly rejected the 8 GiB tmpfs capacity; all 11 cases passed on disk-backed scratch with the reserve unchanged. Two inherited Doctor warning assertions were fixed upstream by 0dc209168731. check-changed, CLI update types, lint, boundary lint, three Knip scans, and P2 review passed. The separate SQLite-spy fix landed upstream in 800fce298ba8 and is not duplicated. No test cases or CI work were added.

items.title: fix(worker): replay transient transcript commit failures
items.summary: fix(worker): replay transient transcript commit failures Restore reconnect and exact-batch replay for owner-classified SQLite contention, temporary admission refusals, cancellation, and unavailable workers. Reconcile unknown SQLite worker receipts through the transcript ledger instead of retaining a terminal RPC rejection. Log the original interruption and preserve the existing terminal path for other failures. Exercise the composed worker run across transient errors and a lost commit receipt, asserting completion, one provider call, and no duplicate messages. Keep deterministic failure and lost-ACK replay coverage intact.
